Is every expense split between everyone: No, only between the members we choose for that expense.
Does the person who paid have to be in t: No. If I buy lunch for two friends and eat nothing, it is split between just them.
Who gets the extra pesewa when a bill do: Any of them, as long as the shares differ by at most one pesewa and add up to the bill.
Can someone pay back more than they owe?: We do not mind for now; just record it.
What does a positive balance mean?: Positive means the others owe you; negative means you owe.
